Question
========
A graph plots the maximum number of requests per second on the Y axis against the amount of resources given to the problem (e.g. CPU cores) on the X axis.

What metric is this graph showing?


Answerlist
----------
* Capacity
* Non-convex performance
* Throughput
* Latency

Solution
========
The quantity measured on the Y axis is a number of requests served per unit of time, which is the definition of throughput.

Answerlist
----------
* 0. Capacity is a threshold read on the curve, it is not the metric being measured.
* 0. This describes the shape of the curve, not the metric.
* 1. Requests per second is a rate of served work, i.e. throughput.
* 0. Latency would be a time per request, not requests per second.
